changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce campaign status at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_campaign ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_campaign_status CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'SUBMISSION_IN_PROGRESS', 'SUBMITTED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'PAUSED'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce campaign_config status at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_campaign_config ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_campaign_config_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
